dogecoin.text: @cb_doge @MyDogeOfficial Where's the hope in $DOGE, @cb_doge? I rather hope you don't think of "making a shıtload of money without working for it" as #hope. @cb_doge @MyDogeOfficial @elonmusk Why do you do this to yourself, @cb_doge? Does it really feel that good? I suppose that's what I told myself when I was a hopeless drunk.

Why? for MONEY? Is this really merely because you think that $DOGE will solve all your problems overnight, with one massive jackpot win?

@elonmusk @cb_doge @dogeofficialceo @TheDogePoundNFT @dogecoin @teslaownersSV @RichardDawkins @EricRWeinstein @bariweiss @charlesmurray @ESYudkowsky "Meme" was invented by one of the world's greatest scientists—Dr. @RichardDawkins—and therefore the concept must be valid and treated as scientific reality, in the minds of the "dark intellectual" crowd who speak so freely of mind viruses.

But there's no proof memes even exist.

@elonmusk @cb_doge @dogeofficialceo @TheDogePoundNFT @dogecoin @teslaownersSV @RichardDawkins @EricRWeinstein @bariweiss @charlesmurray Therefore it's unlikely that Dr. @RichardDawkins has ever needed to give "memetics" any genuine intellectual substance or scientific examination. @elonmusk @cb_doge @dogeofficialceo @TheDogePoundNFT @dogecoin @teslaownersSV @RichardDawkins @EricRWeinstein But I suspect this is typical of the flaccid, flabby intellectual culture of "@bariweiss University". @elonmusk @cb_doge @dogeofficialceo @TheDogePoundNFT @dogecoin @teslaownersSV I hope more people notice that the "dark intellectual" crowd—the august company of Dr. @RichardDawkins and @EricRWeinstein and so forth—often invoke the concept of memetics, the way that @elonmusk burbles about the "woke mind virus", but they are never *analytical* about memes.

@elonmusk @cb_doge @dogeofficialceo @TheDogePoundNFT @dogecoin @teslaownersSV Think of how many memes have been based specifically on Gene Wilder's depiction of Willy Wonka.

This meme gets a double dose of fame—no, a treble dose: once from Roald Dahl, once from Wilder's iconic performance, and once from Willy Wonka himself, who's become a separate brand. https://t.co/HURDalABeG

@elonmusk @cb_doge @dogeofficialceo @TheDogePoundNFT @dogecoin I don't know if @elonmusk, the King of #Memes if you believe @cb_doge or @teslaownersSV, has ever devoted any of his supergenius brain cycles to analysis of memes. Have you noticed, Mr. Musk, how many memes are based on images of someone who's already famous? Actors, usually?

@elonmusk @cb_doge @dogeofficialceo @TheDogePoundNFT @dogecoin I'm not sure it's universally true of all memes, but I suspect that it's true of most of them: at some point, the meme experienced a direct intersection with *fame*.

It's like Homestar Runner, already Internet-famous and wildly popular, gave the picture of Kabosu a kiss of life.

@cb_doge @dogecoin Which of those two things, Mx. @cb_doge, do you think has more long-term value? The United States, or the $DOGE meme?

Mx. @elonmusk? Any genius thoughts here?

@cb_doge @dogecoin Think of it this way, Mx. @cb_doge. People honor the value of a dollar because it's backed up by the United States, which has been around for a long time and has cops who enforce laws about money. People honor the value of $DOGE only because they're addicted to an image of a dog.
@JohnTaylor8888 @cb_doge I think that's because @cb_doge is upset that Elon Musk is doing badly in the press, and is ramping up his $DOGE hype to compensate.

@elonmusk @pmarca @sama @mattyglesias @chrisheatherly @Matjazs @jack But it MIGHT some day be worth millions!
